convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iCustom with standard CMO indicator parameters and straightforward crossover entry/exit logic with fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic, no grid, no martingale, no multi-timeframe complexity.

derived_values.name: Slow CMO period derived from input Periods

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: Duplex CMO strategy uses two CMO indicators (fast and slow) of the same type with different periods. The slow period is derived as 2x the fast period input. Signal reversal logic closes opposite positions on crossover/crossunder. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
external_dependencies: CMO (custom indicator required for iCustom calls)
python_conversion_notes: The CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) must be implemented in Python since it is a custom indicator not available in standard libraries. The CMO formula is: CMO = 100 * (Sum(Up) - Sum(Down)) / (Sum(Up) + Sum(Down)) over N periods. Two instances needed with fast and slow periods. SL/TP pip values require digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). The EA operates on new bar guard only, so resample to bar frequency before signal generation.
